# Vendored C libraries

These are the sources of the native runtimes (ADR 0037). `build.rs` packs them into the binary, comments removed except each file's license header, and `src/rt.rs` compiles them into the cache the first time a program needs them. Nothing here is compiled by `cargo build`.

| Directory | Library | Version | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sqlite/` | SQLite amalgamation | 3.54.0 | Public domain | `sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` as released (sqlite-amalgamation-3540000.zip, SHA3-256 7b670a62fdfbd672b75fef004cb703c8a3e87d3a5cc7d675b4a08337004a2d93) |
| `monocypher/` | Monocypher | 4.0.3 | BSD-2-Clause or CC0-1.0 (`LICENCE.md`) | `src/` and `src/optional/` as released |
| `libsodium/` | libsodium | 1.0.22 | ISC (`LICENSE`); the SHA-256 file is BSD-2-Clause | `crypto_hash/sha256/cp/hash_sha256_cp.c` and `crypto_auth/hmacsha256/auth_hmacsha256.c` as released; `crypto_rt.c` provides what they include |
| `miniz/` | miniz | 3.1.2 | MIT (`LICENSE`) | `miniz.c` and `miniz.h` from the release zip |
| `zstd/` | Zstandard | 1.5.7 | BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE`), from its BSD or GPLv2 dual license | `zstd.c` generated by `build/single_file_libs/combine.py -r lib -x legacy/zstd_legacy.h -o zstd.c zstd-sspur-in.c`; `zstd-sspur-in.c` is upstream's `zstd-in.c` without the dictionary builder and multithreading |
